# Learning Path

Use the three stages to build and check a price predictor. Each stage has a short reading and a calculation you can do by hand.

## Stage 1 — Programming Foundations
*Goal: express a calculation in a reusable function.* → MOC: [[Programming Foundations]]

1. [[Python]]

## Stage 2 — Mathematics
*Goal: represent a small set of measurements.* → MOC: [[Mathematics]]

1. [[Vectors]] → [[Dot Products]]

## Stage 4 — Classical Machine Learning
*Goal: fit a straight line and interpret its residuals.* → MOC: [[Machine Learning]]

1. [[Linear Regression]] → [[Residual Analysis]]

✅ **Checkpoint:** [[Project - Calibrate a Sensor]]
